notes.title: Belated Wot I Think: Four Sided Fantasy
notes.content:
For a while there, back in 2014, we were rather excited to see Four Sided Fantasy [official site]. Then things went quiet. And then, er, the game came out last August. Oops. So why now? Well, I was looking up Four Last Things, the bonkers (and a bit annoying, honestly) Renaissance painting adventure, and clicked the wrong button. Yeah. Welcome to RPS.

Crikey, Four Sided Fantasy is rather good. It’s not too late to tell you. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Four Sided Fantasy Patch Released!
notes.content:
A patch has been released for Four Sided Fantasy. This patch fixes many of the issues that players have brought up since launch. The changes include:

-Fixed being able to fall through floors in cases where player let go of screen lock right as they reached the bottom of the screen.

-On controllers, B button/O button was pausing the game. This has been fixed.

-"No wrap zones" would sometimes respawn, making puzzles impossible to beat without going back to the main menu. This has been fixed. "No wrap zones" no longer respawn under any circumstances.

-Added wrap and lock counters to the pause menu, so that players can keep track of the number of screen locks and number of screen wraps for the achievements.

-Fixed save bug that locked previously unlocked levels in the level select.

-Fixed achievements, achievements will unlock correctly now.

-Fixed memory leak.

Please let us know what you think in the forums, and let us know if you run into any issues!

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Four Sided Fantasy, 10% off!
notes.content:
Four Sided Fantasy is Now Available on Steam and is 10% off!*

A game about the limits of your screen. Four Sided Fantasy is a seamless experience where you wrap the screen to solve mind-bending puzzles. Play as a man and woman who attempt to find each other throughout four seasons in a year, constantly separated by the boundaries of the screen.

*Offer ends September 6 at 10AM Pacific Time
